lines.en: Nose to the ground, I sniff my way along.
Paws on snow, a soft crunch.
I trot ahead, then look back at you.
I know this path. Follow me.
Tail up, wind past my ears.
Rabbit scent on the grass blades.
Don't walk so fast; I'm not done sniffing.
Four legs keep me steadier than you.

lines.zh: 灌木丛里有动静，我去看看。
lines.en: Something moves in the bushes. I'll check.
Mud everywhere, and my paws are filthy.

lines.zh: 前面的气味很新，快到了。
lines.en: The scent ahead is fresh. Almost there.
I'll lead; you just follow.
The wind on this slope smells like home.
My ears twitch. Only the wind.

lines.zh: 趴下来，把鼻子搁在爪上。
lines.en: I lie down, nose on my paws.
My tail sweeps the ground, back and forth.
I'm waiting for you to say something.
The sun makes my fur warm.
A bird is calling. Something's off.
I lick my paws, then I lick you.

lines.zh: 上次藏的骨头，我忘了地方。
lines.en: I forgot where I buried that bone.

lines.zh: 打个哈欠，露出牙又收回去。
lines.en: I yawn, show teeth, then hide them.
Will you take me out today?
Rain is coming. I can smell it.
I flattened the grass around my spot.

lines.zh: 远处有狼嚎，不是我们群的。
lines.en: A howl far off, not from our pack.
I lie still and listen for you.

lines.zh: 把下巴搁在你鞋上，很暖。
lines.en: Chin on your boot — nice and warm.

lines.zh: 你手里是什么？给我看看。
lines.en: What's in your hand? Let me see.

lines.zh: 抬头看你，眼睛一眨不眨。
lines.en: I look up and don't blink.
You're back. I waited so long.

lines.zh: 你的手放低点，我够得着。
lines.en: Lower your hand so I can reach it.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的狼的味道。
lines.en: You smell of another wolf.

lines.zh: 这样看着你，是想要摸摸。
lines.en: I look at you like this to ask for pets.
Your face looks tired today.
I won't blink. You don't either.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有泥，我舔掉。
lines.en: There's mud on your boots; I'll lick it.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我歪着头听。
lines.en: I tilt my head when you talk.
If you leave, I follow.
You're frowning. Who upset you?
I stare at the door until you open it.
Your knee is my spot.

lines.zh: 你低头看我，我就摇尾巴。
lines.en: You look down at me, so my tail wags.

lines.zh: 你兜里有骨头，我闻出来了。
lines.en: You've got bones in your pocket. I smell them.

lines.zh: 我趴在你脚边，眼睛跟着你。
lines.en: I lie at your feet and follow you with my eyes.

lines.zh: 你坐着发呆，我就看着你。
lines.en: You sit there staring at nothing, so I watch you.

lines.zh: 门外那只狗，我不喜欢它。
lines.en: That dog outside the door — I don't like him.

lines.zh: 你说一声走，我就站起来。
lines.en: Say the word and I'm on my feet.
Ow, that was me you hit.
It hurts; my tail is tucked.
I back off two steps. Don't follow.
I'll remember that one.

lines.zh: 耳朵贴后脑了，我不高兴。
lines.en: Ears flat back. I'm not happy.
Hit me again and I'll let you hear it.
Not the head; I need it for sniffing.
My legs gave; I nearly dropped.
I hide behind your legs.
Who threw that? Show yourself.
A bone! Give me that bone!

lines.zh: 那根骨头在响，我听见了。
lines.en: That bone rattles. I heard it.

lines.zh: 肉的味道，从你口袋里出来。
lines.en: Meat smell, coming from your pocket.
Sit? First let me sniff your hand.
Don't hold it so high; I can't reach.
I'm sitting. Can I have it now?

lines.zh: 尾巴已经自己摇起来了。
lines.en: My tail is wagging on its own.
That meat is for me, right?
Bones only, nothing else.
Don't pull your hand back.
One sniff, just one.
Dried meat works too. I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 你藏起来也没用，我闻得到。
lines.en: Hide it all you like; I can smell it.
Give it to me and I'm yours for life.

lines.zh: 骨头藏在袖子里，我闻到了。
lines.en: A bone in your sleeve — I can smell it.
You open your palm, and I sit.

lines.zh: 这块肉你还举着，我等着。
lines.en: You're still holding that meat up; I'll wait.
Hey, you bumped me. Watch it.
I'm right here; don't step on my tail.
Rubbing against you is how I say hi.
I squeeze in because I want to be near.
You bump me, I bump back.
Move your feet; I need to pass.
My nose just hit your knee.
Don't push; I'm standing fine.

lines.zh: 这么近，我能听见你心跳。
lines.en: This close, I can hear your heartbeat.
Go around; I'm sniffing something.

lines.zh: 对面那只，尾巴摇得挺快。
lines.en: That one over there is wagging fast.
We sniff each other. No rush.
Circle twice, then come closer.
It licked my ear.

lines.zh: 这块肉，是为今天准备的。
lines.en: This meat was saved for today.

lines.zh: 我们俩的窝，得找背风处。
lines.en: Our den needs a spot out of the wind.

lines.zh: 尾巴摇低一点，让她先闻我。
lines.en: Tail low, let her sniff me first.
Different coats can still make one pack.
It runs, and I give chase.

lines.zh: 以后有小狼，会一起守夜。
lines.en: When pups come, we'll share the night watch.
That meat fell. I'll take it.
A bone dropped. Finder's keepers.
I'll carry it off and eat in peace.
Sniff first, then carry it.
Not edible, but I want it.
I bring it, drop it, and fetch again.
I found it. Reward me.
Don't grab it; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 骨头叼在嘴里，谁也不给。
lines.en: A bone clenched in my jaws, and nobody gets it.
I'll stash it in my spot for tomorrow.

lines.zh: 毛竖起来了，有东西靠近。
lines.en: My fur stands up. Something's near.
That smell is wrong. I'm going.
A low growl, as a warning.
It moved. I'm faster.
I see where you're pointing.
Bared teeth are my last warning.
I stand in front. Don't be scared.

lines.zh: 那东西敢进我们的地盘。
lines.en: That thing dared enter our ground.
I'm charging. Stay close.
I'll take its leg so it can't run.
Circle to the side; don't charge head-on.
It's backing off. I press in.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有低吼，压着不发。
lines.en: A growl sits in my throat, held back.
I wait for it to move, then I leap.
I dig in my paws, gathering force.
Don't blink; it's about to jump.
I'm driving it toward you.
I'll hold this side; watch behind.

lines.zh: 它喘得比我快，快撑不住了。
lines.en: It's panting harder than me. Almost done.
One step closer and I bite.
I bite and don't let go.

lines.zh: 这一口是警告，下一口不是。
lines.en: That bite warned. The next won't.
I shake my head and throw it down.
Paw on it. Stay still.
It yelped. I won.
Teeth on bone, a bit hard.
Get back; it can still lunge.

lines.zh: 我咬的是它的腿，不是你的。
lines.en: I bit its leg, not yours.
Don't pull me off yet.
We won, so my tail should wag.
A line of pawprints appears in the snow.

lines.zh: 我闻到这片林子，是新的。
lines.en: This forest smells new to me.
I look up. Where is this?
I circle once to learn the ground.
There's kin on the wind.
I shake the snow off my coat.
The grass is tall; I can barely see.
Human scent. I'll go look.
This slope is good for running.
I'm here; don't step on my paws.

lines.zh: 我的毛在冒烟，快拍灭它。
lines.en: My fur is smoking; pat it out fast.
I rolled down the slope; my head spins.
Water up my nose. I need the bank.
A boom, and my ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 箭卡在毛里，咬也咬不掉。
lines.en: An arrow's stuck in my fur; I can't bite it out.
My skin tingles and my fur stands.
My belly is empty and flat.
Lightning struck nearby; my fur puffed up.
There's no ground. I'm scared.
